summary.text: Anne Backus is the Democratic candidate for Tennessee House of Representatives District 33 in the November 3, 2026 general election; a retired Y-12 National Security Complex program manager from Anderson County, she is running on public education, affordable health care and a living wage.

paragraphs.text: Anne Backus was born in Pensacola, Florida, and earned a bachelor's degree from Mississippi State University in 1980.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as program manager and says she has been affiliated with CASA, PFLAG, her church, and the Democratic Party at the state and county level.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she spent 33 years at the Y-12 National Security Complex as a project and program manager and now volunteers across Anderson County.
Backus said in the survey that she became involved in a Democratic candidate's 2022 campaign for the District 33 seat, trained with Emerge Tennessee, and ran for the seat in 2024.
She said she serves on the Tennessee Democratic Party Executive Committee and volunteers as a CASA advocate.
Her stated priorities include defending public education and opposing private school vouchers, affordable health care, eliminating the state sales tax on groceries, and a living wage.
